mapper.select:
SELECT id, name, department, position, phone, work_status AS workStatus, create_time AS createTime FROM maintenance_staff
deleted = 0
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND department = #{department}
AND position LIKE CONCAT('%', #{position}, '%')
AND work_status = #{workStatus}
ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalStaff, SUM(CASE WHEN work_status = '在岗' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active, SUM(CASE WHEN work_status = '休假' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onLeave, SUM(CASE WHEN work_status = '离职' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resigned, COUNT(DISTINCT department) AS departmentCount FROM maintenance_staff WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN work_status = '在岗' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCount FROM maintenance_staff WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY department ORDER BY count ASC
